partnership_announcements.description: Sadr Logistics signed a 10-year warehousing services contract (PL2) with Starlinks for Sadr Park, valued at SAR 249.34 million (ex-VAT). Starting September 2025, Starlinks will lease warehouses and cold storage to operate and store client goods; Sadr expects financial impact from Q3 2025.

overview_description.description: Sadr Logistics Services specializes in storage systems, handling, warehousing, and warehouse automation solutions. They provide storage solutions, warehousing, pallets, and office shelving solutions, as well as designing shelves, providing handling equipment, and other products.

about_short_description.short_description: Sadr Logistics Services manufactures and supplies metal shelves and storage systems for warehouses.

product.name: Storage Solutions
product.description: Designs, manufactures, and assembles industrial pallet racking systems for various loads including pallets, coil support, metallic crates, and containers.

product.name: Warehousing
product.description: Provides a well-equipped warehouse in Riyadh with over 25,000 square meters of storage area, capable of accommodating more than 30,000 pallet positions for dry, ambient, and cold storage.

product.name: Pallets
product.description: Supplies various types of pallets including wooden, plastic, and steel, suitable for different load weights and resistance factors.

product.name: Handling Equipment
product.description: Offers a range of material handling equipment and machinery to facilitate logistical operations in warehouses.

product.name: Office Solutions
product.description: Provides office storage solutions in various designs and colors to meet different customer needs.
